selection_principle: test only environment axes with an explicit functional rationale; do not expose every endpoint to the same predictor set
multiplicity_rule: BH-FDR separately within each biological hypothesis family
spatial_rule: send q<0.05 rows to the existing spherical-basis spatial sensitivity; require p<0.05, residual Moran p>=0.05, and stable sign for linear endpoints
phylogeny_rule: send spatial-pass rows to the frozen 52-tree Pagel-lambda placement sensitivity; require 52/52 successful trees, p<0.05 in all trees, and stable sign for linear endpoints
honesty_note: Most Chapter 1 outcomes were already known before this registry was written. Only orientation x BIO12 was already frozen as a targeted candidate in the repository.
